title: nepeta cataria f. laurentii
intro: Nepeta cataria f. laurentii, commonly known as Catmint 'Walker's Low', is a cultivar of the catmint plant, a member of the mint family (Lamiaceae) known for its ornamental and medicinal properties. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and anxiety, improving sleep quality, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Nepeta cataria f. laurentii include acting as a nervine, sedative, and antispasmodic, making it useful for treating nervous disorders and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include nepetalactone, a potent insect repellent, and volatile oils such as borneol and camphor, which contribute to its medicinal and fragrant properties.
